test.title: Issue26 faithful printed-first-word readings

populationRules.all-text: All source text rows, including inserted label when that policy is selected.
populationRules.prose-only: role exactly body-prose; standalone label is excluded.
populationRules.emphasis-only: role other than body-prose, including inserted label.

parameters.surfaceMeaning: Use the frozen reviewed fields literally; outer punctuation already stripped by source convention; internal punctuation, fused forms and printed hyphenation retained. Raster witnesses do not establish original digital Unicode codepoints.
parameters.STOPPolicyMeaning: Exclude the side label; replace the anchored row token with STOP without changing that row role/rank; or insert the separate label immediately before the anchor. Units without the anchor are unchanged.
parameters.parityDefinition: One-based rank within the current unit after STOP policy; either before or after population filtering. Source ID suffixes never determine parity.
parameters.operationOrder: Unit -> STOP policy -> population/rank -> parity -> row order -> projection -> character order.
parameters.initialFinalRule: First/last Unicode alphanumeric character of each reviewed token, with case preserved.
parameters.bip39Tokenization: Lowercase unfiltered lexical tokens; ordinary punctuation bounds words; invalid decoded group ␞ is a hard region boundary. Non-dictionary tokens are not discarded.
parameters.hexMatching: 64hex and SEC records require non-hex boundaries. Other registered record shapes may be embedded in longer text.
parameters.unknownFirstWordPolicy: Any unverified, empty or malformed source first-word field prevents a complete result; never silently omit or guess it.
parameters.emptyUnits: Retain labeled empty readings; deduplicate actual forms in the shared evaluator.

test.negativeCriterion: A complete zero result excludes only the declared literal/private/public records in these fixed first-word-derived readings from the pinned Issue26 witnesses. It does not test full alternate lines, another source, arbitrary ciphers or authenticate the 20-BTC claim.
limitations: This eligible pre-December2022 column is not authenticated as the March2023 20-BTC target.
Printed line starts are reviewed; full-line OCR is unverified, including23 obscured page102 endings. Full-line/alternate-line exclusion is outside scope.
STOP placement, population, parity and mirror variants are correlated declared conventions, not independent theories or evidence of intent.
First-word surfaces are raster transcription conventions; original digital punctuation/Unicode bytes are unavailable.
A valid private record, encrypted record, address or public point is only a lead requiring separate review; no wallet action follows.

candidatePrivacy: Raw readings and candidate locators remain private until reviewed; publish only domain-separated safe fingerprints for valid private records. A record/point/address is a lead, not an authenticated prize. No address queries or transactions.
